training.notes: 140 ground plots on northern Vancouver Island, British Columbia; area-based ALS model for Lorey's mean height. Dominant sampled species were Cw, Hw, and Hm; deciduous-leading plots were part of the sample but are outside this card's applicability. Source: White et al. (2015), Forests 6:3704, https://doi.org/10.3390/f6103704.

validation.notes: ALS model in Table 10; observed mean Lorey's mean height 32.10 m. Reported RMSE is 2.88 m and bias is 0.05 m.

applicability.notes: Coastal western hemlock (CWH) stands on northern Vancouver Island, BC. The published model was developed for the sampled coastal mixed-conifer population; do not apply outside that domain.

notes: Published model card, metadata only. The source is a Random Forests area-based model; the published coefficients/forest objects are not copied here. The card makes the claim inspectable; it is not a local validation.
